properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 4:12AM CDT until August 9 at 4:30AM CDT by NWS Sioux Falls SD
properties.description:
At 412 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Terril, or 11
miles southwest of Estherville, moving northeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Terril and Lost Island Lake.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

To report severe weather contact your nearest law enforcement agency.
They will send your report to the National Weather Service office in
Sioux Falls.

NWSheadline: A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 430 AM CDT FOR SOUTHEASTERN DICKINSON AND NORTHEASTERN CLAY COUNTIES

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 4:11AM CDT until August 9 at 5:00AM CDT by NWS Sioux Falls SD
properties.description:
At 411 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over West Okoboji,
or near Spirit Lake, moving northeast at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Golf ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect wind
damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

This severe storm will be near...
Spirit Lake, Milford, Arnolds Park, Okoboji, Orleans, Wahpeton,
and West Okoboji around 415 AM CDT.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

To report severe weather contact your nearest law enforcement agency.
They will send your report to the National Weather Service office in
Sioux Falls.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 4:12AM CDT until August 9 at 4:45AM CDT by NWS Aberdeen SD
properties.description:
SVRABR

The National Weather Service in Aberdeen has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southwestern Spink County in northeastern South Dakota...

* Until 445 AM CDT.

* At 412 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Redfield,
moving southeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Redfield, Tulare, Frankfort, Twin Lakes, Spottswood and Cottonwood
Lake.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.
